metadata.pr_title: feat: New parser component with multiple input types and stringify add on
metadata.pr_description:
This pull request introduces a new `ParserComponent` to the processing components, along with corresponding tests. The changes include adding the new component, updating the `__init__.py` file to include it, and creating comprehensive tests to ensure its functionality.

New component addition:

* [`src/backend/base/langflow/components/processing/parser.py`](diffhunk://#diff-29a97ab74439e04da182e9e29190dceb202021031cb27e042fda964f7c4a6a61R1-R171): Added the `ParserComponent` class, which formats `DataFrame` or `Data` objects into text using a template. It includes various input configurations and methods for parsing and validating data.

Updates to component initialization:

* [`src/backend/base/langflow/components/processing/__init__.py`](diffhunk://#diff-8922e8706d0ff2afc9d97b98a20a3dad72329ddd488eea4623bd109bc1144a4dR12): Added import and registration of the new `ParserComponent`. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-8922e8706d0ff2afc9d97b98a20a3dad72329ddd488eea4623bd109bc1144a4dR12) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-8922e8706d0ff2afc9d97b98a20a3dad72329ddd488eea4623bd109bc1144a4dR30)

Testing additions:

* [`src/backend/tests/unit/components/processing/test_parser_component.py`](diffhunk://#diff-e5752ac84947b6fa95576396fdbcd3e17f14dbdf04e7ff6b6e10a58830cacbe2R1-R212): Added unit tests for `ParserComponent`, covering various scenarios such as parsing data frames, handling invalid input types, and using custom separators.

Minor formatting changes:

* [`src/backend/tests/unit/api/v1/test_api_schemas.py`](diffhunk://#diff-ce8fb305757f76c8971bf191a9cd12023ad77feca0b237f6c29ca9b5bfec5ca5R9): Added a blank line for formatting consistency.
* [`src/backend/tests/unit/components/helpers/test_structured_output_component.py`](diffhunk://#diff-8896f16f82913e7b94630df33d317f9ba7f15fbaaee95983306d53e97e02ec95L9-R10): Adjusted import formatting.
* [`src/backend/tests/unit/mock_language_model.py`](diffhunk://#diff-d787d779739c27e8faf20b188a502bab23c059f6bde36d792de4ca3fb3d7cdafL4-R7): Adjusted import formatting.
* [`src/backend/tests/unit/serialization/test_serialization.py`](diffhunk://#diff-07ba5bd911a56b57a5bb0e7210dbe2d25ee813c663f45e343d1fe919fd694d6fR12): Added a blank line for formatting consistency.
* [`src/backend/tests/unit/test_schema.py`](diffhunk://#diff-8a50c216442c34aa342fce856e8a7bea5631335145293184a5283bfa95aa4c11R10): Added a blank line for formatting consistency.

review_planner.summary: The diff introduces a new `ParserComponent` in the processing module, along with its corresponding tests. The component formats a DataFrame or Data object into text using a template or converts it to a string. The review focuses on verifying correctness, security, performance, and general aspects of this new functionality.

tasks.title: Security Review for ParserComponent
tasks.description: Verify there are no security vulnerabilities in the new `ParserComponent`. Specifically, check for injection attacks in the template formatting and ensure that the input handling does not expose any security risks.

tasks.title: Logic Review for ParserComponent
tasks.description: Verify the logic of the `ParserComponent` to ensure correct parsing and stringification of DataFrame and Data objects. Check the `_clean_args`, `parse_combined_text`, and `_safe_convert` methods for correct behavior and error handling.

tasks.title: Performance Review for ParserComponent
tasks.description: Evaluate the performance implications of the new `ParserComponent`, especially in the `_clean_args`, `parse_combined_text`, and `_safe_convert` methods. Consider edge cases with large DataFrames or Data objects and verify that the component handles them efficiently.

tasks.title: General Review for ParserComponent Tests
tasks.description: Review the unit tests in `test_parser_component.py` to ensure they cover all aspects of the `ParserComponent`, including edge cases and error conditions. Verify that the tests are comprehensive and provide sufficient coverage for the new functionality.
